## Walkthrough

This PR consolidates elastic job annotation handling by introducing a shared constant `ElasticJobAnnotation`, implementing `IsElasticWorkload()` detection logic with feature gating, and updating workload slicing and topology-aware scheduling to use the unified constant and detection function. Test coverage is extended with the annotation on elastic workload test cases and new test sub-cases for regular jobs.

## Changes

**Elastic Job Annotation Consolidation**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Annotation constant and elastic workload detection** <br> `pkg/constants/constants.go`, `pkg/workload/workload.go`|Introduced `ElasticJobAnnotation` constant and `IsElasticWorkload()` helper function that gates elastic detection on `ElasticJobsViaWorkloadSlices` feature and validates annotation value.|
|**Workload slicing annotation key consolidation** <br> `pkg/workloadslicing/workloadslicing.go`|Updated `EnabledAnnotationKey` to reference the shared `ElasticJobAnnotation` constant instead of hardcoded string.|
|**TAS flavor assigner elastic workload handling** <br> `pkg/scheduler/flavorassigner/tas_flavorassigner.go`|Modified `WorkloadsTopologyRequests` to detect elastic workloads via `IsElasticWorkload()` and enforce `ElasticJobsViaWorkloadSlicesWithTAS` feature gate; records error and skips processing when gate is disabled.|
|**Test updates for elastic job annotation and topology requests** <br> `pkg/scheduler/flavorassigner/flavorassigner_test.go`|Added `metav1` import, annotated test workloads with elastic-job annotation in required/preferred/unconstrained topology test cases, and added new sub-tests validating that regular jobs accept required and preferred topology requests under feature gate.|

### Review by [@sohankunkerkar](https://github.com/sohankunkerkar) (commented) — 2026-06-08T21:33:49Z

Thanks for working on this!The fix direction is right. I have left a few comments. I think [this](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/pull/11997/changes#r3376451022) should address your CI failures.

- **pkg/scheduler/flavorassigner/tas_flavorassigner.go:64** by [@sohankunkerkar](https://github.com/sohankunkerkar) — 2026-06-08T21:24:32Z
```diff
@@ -58,9 +58,14 @@ func (a *Assignment) WorkloadsTopologyRequests(log logr.Logger, wl *workload.Inf
 			}
 			isTASImplied := isTASImplied(&podSet, cq)
 
-			// Only unconstrained topology is supported with elastic workload slices.
 			var previousAssignment *kueue.TopologyAssignment
-			if features.Enabled(features.ElasticJobsViaWorkloadSlicesWithTAS) {
+
+			// Only unconstrained topology is supported with elastic workload slices.
+			if workload.IsElasticWorkload(wl.Obj) {
```

  This block now runs for elastic workloads even when `ElasticJobsViaWorkloadSlicesWithTAS` is off. On main, the gate check was the outer guard and gate off meant the entire block was skipped. Now the annotation check is the outer guard, so elastic workloads enter the block and immediately hit the "gate not enabled" error. They never get a topology assignment.
  
  Please combine both conditions in the outer guard.
  ```go
  if workload.IsElasticWorkload(wl.Obj) && features.Enabled(features.ElasticJobsViaWorkloadSlicesWithTAS) 
  ```

- **pkg/workload/workload.go:1981** by [@sohankunkerkar](https://github.com/sohankunkerkar) — 2026-06-08T21:28:47Z
```diff
@@ -1977,3 +1977,12 @@ func TASAssignedNodeNames(wl *kueue.Workload) []string {
 	}
 	return nodesSet.UnsortedList()
 }
+
```
